items.title: Uber Technologies (UBER) Partnerships Expand As Driverless Debate Keeps Valuation In Focus
items.summary: Uber Technologies (UBER) has been in focus after a series of retail and delivery partnerships, ranging from Kohl’s and Tractor Supply in the U.S. to Kijiji and Best Buy in Canada. Despite this run of new partnerships, Uber Technologies' recent share price performance has been weak, with the stock down 22.68% year to date and the 1-year total shareholder return declining 23.44%, while the 5-year total shareholder return is up 61.39%.
